stage_conditions.bind_identities: every identity is verified BEFORE anything expensive: the image digest, the live executable digest, the teacher revision, both calibration mixtures by spec and by content hash, the configured space, and the frozen baseline construction. A disagreement stops the session at approximately $0 rather than after the first level of the beam.
stage_conditions.search_and_baseline: the beam search runs inside its own envelope, which excludes the baseline rebuild reserve; the ranking is committed the instant it exists rather than at closeout; and the baseline B is resolved exactly once -- searched if the beam re-derived it, rebuilt through the frozen C1 fixed path if not. Once the beam search has BEGUN, a failure is not retried: preserve, tear down, reconcile, report.
stage_conditions.interpretation: the state_eval ranking is hypothesis-generation evidence. A search winner is not a demonstrated initialization improvement, behavioural confirmation is a separately authorized experiment, and Search-2 is not reachable from this session.

scope_note: exactly ONE Phase-C2 Search-1 launcher session at a hard ceiling of $15.0446: one beam search over the frozen four-operator Search-1 space under SCHEDULE_V1 (beam width 6, one warmup level), ATTENTION fixed to attention.activation_importance_v1 and branched only across its two declared calibration profiles, DEPTH/FFN/RESIDUAL_WIDTH held at their accepted profiles, operator order free; plus, CONDITIONALLY, exactly one rebuild of the frozen C1 baseline B when the deterministic rule finds the beam did not re-derive it; plus the required c2_baseline_comparison.json B->C search-stage evidence. Nothing in the space, the schedule, the profiles, the B identity contract or the pricing semantics may move.
enforcement: the launcher loads this artifact and refuses to create a pod whose priced hard threshold exceeds hard_cap_usd or per_launch_hard_usd, refuses a stage not in authorized_stages, refuses a harness that does not digest to the authorized value, and has no code path to any experiment after Phase A

resource_scope._what_a_provider_resource_is: a resource the provider RETURNED AN ID FOR. A create call that returns no id created nothing and billed nothing, so it does not consume this count; it is still recorded as a draw with pod_id null, because the provider's refusal is the only evidence of why.
resource_scope._what_this_does_not_relax: the dollar ceiling, which every draw in the session shares, and the runner's requirement that the provider confirm a resource is not billing before the next one is created.

approved_money._ceiling_rule: $15.0446 is the MAXIMUM authorization for this session and every provider resource inside it shares it. C1's $15.1475 is never substituted.
approved_money.price_rule: the live NVIDIA L40S securePrice must be re-queried immediately before provider creation. ABOVE $1.09/h the session STOPS at $0.

one_use.what_that_means: this authorization funds ONE launcher session. Inside it the launcher may replace a host that never became usable, up to three provider resources in total, ALL sharing this session's single $15.0446 ceiling. The three are host draws inside one launcher session, NOT three scientific attempts. A create request that returns no provider resource id created nothing and is not a provider resource. The next resource is not created until the provider confirms the previous one is no longer billing.
one_use.machine_readable: the four values above are copied into the authorization as C2ResourceScope and checked by resource_scope_gate before provider creation.
one_use.consumed_when: the formal launcher is invoked under this authorization, whether or not a provider resource follows and whether or not any money is spent.
one_use.retry_rule: under the 2026-09-16 campaign decision, an ordinary failure BEFORE the beam search or any scientific measurement begins is an engineering failure: preserve evidence, provider-confirmed teardown, reconcile spend, diagnose, minimal repair, minimal relevant regression, fresh executable identity, fresh run identity and a complete fresh chain, and continue automatically -- but only while the next full $15.0446 ceiling still fits inside the $16.20 campaign envelope. Attempts 2 and 3 were both closed under this rule. Once the beam search has begun, NO automatic formal retry is authorized: preserve, tear down, reconcile and return.
